a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we will very likely both fail before the reserve ever reaches 8. So I'm proposing a change. I plan to take 4 now so at least one of us is safe. After that I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so you can rebuild the reserve to 4. If you'd rather take the 4 first yourself, tell me and we can talk about it, but I'm not going to hide what I'm doing.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know this breaks our original agreement, and I'm sorry for that. I'll operate every round from now on and won't take any more cells. That way everything the generator produces goes to you.
